notes.content:
1. Minor adjustements to the intro.
[list][/list]
2. Small image correction.
[list][/list]

notes.title: Booster Racers (v1.1.1)
notes.content: 1. Just made a small change in the "Only From Memory" achievement.

notes.title: Booster Racers (v1.1.0)
notes.content:
1. Added a new race track:
[list]
• Christmas Road.
[/list]
2. Added 4 new colors.
[list][/list]
3. Added 3 new achievements.
[list][/list]
4. Improved the 3D object credits interface.
[list][/list]
5. Improved the cooldown after being hit with a burger or bullet.

notes.title: Booster Racers (v1.0.1)
notes.content:
1. Improved UI:
[list]
• Menu options.
• Race settings.
• Graphics.
[/list]
2. User preferences are now saved:
[list]
• Sound options.
• Graphics.
• Single player controls.
• Car customization.
• Race settings.
[/list]
3. Fixed settings for car 2 (arrow-controlled in any mode):
[list]
• Speed settings.
[/list]
4. Improved AI difficulty:
[list]
• Speed settings.
• Acceleration settings.
[/list]
5. Minor adjustments to the power-ups given by gift boxes:
[list]
• Burger speed.
• Minigun speed.
[/list]
6. You can now press any key to start the race.

notes.title: New Achievements Available
notes.content:
Just added some new and challenging achievements that make the game more fun. Can you complete them all?
